description: The pairing of a tool result with its call by callId (ui/src/lib/task-view.ts) and the naming of a receipt by the structured input of its call (ui/src/lib/tool-labels.ts), judged by ui/tests/task-view.test.mjs and ui/tests/format.test.mjs. The component that shows the label (ToolReceipt.tsx) is rendered by ui/tests/conversation-core.test.mjs, which bundles React from node_modules: the mutation tool does not copy node_modules, so that component is not mutated here.

mutations.name: TV1
mutations.what: the id of an event is never read: every result is paired by tool name again

mutations.name: TV2
mutations.what: anything that is not nothing counts as an id (a number, null)

mutations.name: TV3
mutations.what: a result is paired by tool name even when it carries an id

mutations.name: TV4
mutations.what: a result is always paired by id, so a result without one never finds its call

mutations.name: TV5
mutations.what: a call that already has its result can be settled again

mutations.name: TV6
mutations.what: a result may settle a call of an earlier run

mutations.name: TV7
mutations.what: the FIRST open call is settled instead of the last one

mutations.name: TV8
mutations.what: the start of a call forgets its id

mutations.name: TV9
mutations.what: a result that no call claims forgets its own id

mutations.name: TV10
mutations.what: a result that no call claims forgets its checkpoint

mutations.name: TV11
mutations.what: a result that no call claims forgets what its call was about

mutations.name: TV12
mutations.what: the checkpoint of a result never reaches the call it settles

mutations.name: TV13
mutations.what: a call without a checkpoint gets the field set to undefined instead of having none

mutations.name: TL1
mutations.what: the two ends of a move are not named

mutations.name: TL2
mutations.what: a batch does not name its files

mutations.name: TL3
mutations.what: a command is named before a path

mutations.name: TL4
mutations.what: a list of files is named before a move

mutations.name: TL5
mutations.what: the two ends of a move are joined with another sign

mutations.name: TL6
mutations.what: the files of a batch are joined without a space

mutations.name: TL7
mutations.what: something the Hub cut is not marked as cut

mutations.name: TL8
mutations.what: every target is marked as cut

mutations.name: TL9
mutations.what: a move with one end missing prints the missing end

patches.old: const moved = [a.source, a.destination].filter(part => typeof part === 'string' && part !== '').join(' → ');

mutations.name: TL10
mutations.what: an empty end of a move is named

patches.old: const moved = [a.source, a.destination].filter(part => typeof part === 'string' && part !== '')

mutations.name: TL11
mutations.what: entries of the list that are not text are named

mutations.name: TL12
mutations.what: empty entries of the list are named

mutations.name: TL13
mutations.what: a list that is not an array is read as one

mutations.name: TL14
mutations.what: a path that is not text is named

mutations.name: TL15
mutations.what: an empty path hides the command after it

mutations.name: TL16
mutations.what: the cut marker follows any value of the flag, not only true
mutations.equivalent: the Hub sets truncated to true or leaves it out, and the type says boolean: for those inputs a truthiness test and a test against true give the same answer
